name: opt-in-landing-path-allowlisted-query
description: landingPageFormat 'path+allowlisted-query' keeps UTM and click-ID keys (case-insensitive, URL order) and drops every other query key and the fragment.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (opt-in, #56): keeps the gclid-on-landing evidence ruling #12 cared about without other query values. Semver: additive opt-in parse option (minor); defaults, CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
